docker.update_command:
bash -c 'set -euo pipefail
ctr_updater_file="$(mktemp)"
trap '"'"'rm -f -- "$ctr_updater_file"'"'"' EXIT
curl --proto =https --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NoobCity99/CTRoadmap/2ea382b5f1ea982c6c7ed6b90d9b4f8acce30d0e/ctr_update.sh -o "$ctr_updater_file"
printf '"'"'%s  %s\n'"'"' 015ba16f3c42d114da94f9f6b4b5b855f69d9117a893c030871f25cf6b909a75 "$ctr_updater_file" | sha256sum --check --status
chmod +x "$ctr_updater_file"
bash "$ctr_updater_file"'
